scoring: The title comes from the share of the lesson's criteria that are met. A criterion is met if its question is answered correctly on the first attempt or on the re-attempt.
overallTitle: In C9, the overall title comes from the share of all criteria met across the readiness questions.

certificateText.heading: Certificate of completion
certificateText.body: {studentName} completed {lessonsCompleted} of 9 lessons of the COS212 AVL tree app and earned the title {title}.
certificateText.footer: This certificate was generated on {date}. The app does not store the name.
certificateText.bonusNote: It is proposed that completed lessons could earn a bonus of up to 5% on the COS212 module mark, at the module coordinator's discretion.
